date.as_written: saṃvat || 1936 śrīsāstrasaṃvat || 56 | phālguṇa praviṣṭe || 15 || tithi ekādaśyāṃ || guruvāsare

notes: The colophon records the date in Vikrama Samvat 1936 along with Śāstra-saṃvat (Saptarṣi / Laukika era) 56 and solar day (praviṣṭe) 15 of Phālguna. No human agents (scribe, commissioner, owner, king) are named.
